description: Local repository map for multi-repo development: scan every local git repo into an incremental, self-healing index (name, path, read/write role, purpose); a UserPromptSubmit hook auto-injects the path and role whenever a repo name is mentioned, so cross-repo references and edits never need hand-pasted paths; optional macOS launchd scheduled sync keeps new repos in the map. Use when the user works across multiple local repositories or says 仓库地图, repo-map, repo map, 全局项目索引, 跨仓库引用, 找不到本地仓库, 仓库地图定时更新.
